settings.title: Indstillinger
settings.generalDescription: Sprog og udseende for dette dashboard.
settings.compressionDescription: Reducer forespørgslens størrelse før routing, mens kode, fejl, stier, tal og værktøjsdefinitioner bevares.
settings.compressionHelp: Omskriver hver forespørgsel, før den sendes til en udbyder, så den bruger færre tokens. Kode, fejl, filstier og tal er beskyttet, og enhver omskrivning, der beskadiger dem, kasseres.
settings.compressionModeHelp: Fra sender forespørgsler uændret. Tabsfri fjerner kun gentaget og overflødig tekst. Standard forkorter også værktøjsoutput. Aggressiv fortætter desuden ældre replikker.
settings.compressionEnginesHelp: Hver motor er ét omskrivningstrin. Tilstanden afgør, hvilke motorer der kører; slår du en fra her, holdes den ude af alle tilstande.
settings.engineDedupHelp: Erstatter en tekstblok, der allerede er optrådt tidligere i samtalen, med en kort henvisning til den.
settings.engineLiteHelp: Fjerner mellemrum i slutningen af linjer, samler gentagne tomme linjer og dropper duplikerede systembeskeder.
settings.engineReadLifecycleHelp: Erstatter en tidligere fillæsning med en note, når den samme fil læses eller redigeres igen senere.
settings.engineToolfilterHelp: Forkorter output fra kommandoer og værktøjer såsom builds, tests og installationer. Fejl- og stacktrace-linjer bevares altid.
settings.engineJsoncompactHelp: Omkoder lange JSON-arrays med de samme felter som en kompakt tabel. Kan gendannes, så intet går tabt.
settings.engineRelevanceHelp: Fjerner de sætninger, der har mindst med den seneste besked at gøre, når en besked overskrider sit størrelsesbudget.
settings.engineAgingHelp: Fortætter replikker ud over de seneste få til et kort resumé, der bevarer stier, fejl og beslutninger.
settings.engineHardBudgetHelp: Fjerner de mindst værdifulde linjer, indtil forespørgslen passer til tokenmålet.
settings.compressionAutoTriggerHelp: Forespørgsler, der estimeres over dette antal tokens, skifter automatisk til Aggressiv. Lad feltet stå tomt for at slå det fra.
settings.compressionPrefixFreezeHelp: Lader en systemprompt være uændret, når den samme tekst er set tre gange, så udbyderens prompt-caching bliver ved med at virke.
settings.compressionTrustProjectFiltersHelp: Indlæser også filtre for værktøjsoutput fra arbejdsmappen. Slået fra som standard, fordi et repository kunne bruge det til at skjule output for modellen.
settings.compressionPreviewDescription: Send indholdet af en forespørgsel gennem pipelinen for at se, hvad en udbyder ville modtage.
settings.buildAhead: Denne build er foran den officielle main-gren.
settings.buildDiverged: Denne build er divergeret fra den officielle main-gren.
settings.buildUnknown: Denne tilpassede build kan ikke sammenlignes med den officielle main-gren.
settings.checkFailed: Det var ikke muligt at søge efter opdateringer.
settings.contactsGithub: Tjek udføres manuelt og kontakter GitHub.
settings.autoUpdateCheckHelp: Tjekker GitHub én gang om dagen for en ny udgivelse og viser en påmindelse. Slået fra som standard.
settings.restartAfterUpdate: Genstart FreeLLMAPI, når buildet er færdigt.

models.sizeLabelHint: Frontier/Large/Medium/Small fastsætter intelligens-aksen: et højere niveau slår altid et lavere, og inden for et niveau flytter intelligensrangeringen stadig scoren. En model uden et genkendt niveau får den laveste score på denne akse, men intelligens er kun én af tre akser — høj pålidelighed og hastighed kan stadig vinde den en rute.

models.referenceOnlyHint: Listed for comparison only. OpenCode's free tier refuses any call from outside OpenCode, so this model cannot be routed — use it through the opencode CLI instead.

strategies.exploreHint: Give models with no reliability or speed data a 10% chance to go first so they build a track record. Your real request is what gets sent, so it may be answered by an untested model. For a custom endpoint, use Probe endpoint on the Keys page to test it without live traffic.
strategies.keySelectionHint: Hvordan der vælges mellem flere nøgler hos samme udbyder. Automatisk beholder den nuværende rotation; Mindst tilbage rangordner nøglerne efter observeret kvote og prøver først den, der har mest tilbage.
strategies.cooldownCeilingHint: Begrænser, hvor længe routerens egne gæt må bænke et fejlende nøgle- og modelpar. Stigen vokser normalt 2 min, 10 min, 1 t, 24 t, og kredit- eller niveaufejl bænker en dag. Ventetider oplyst af udbyderen forkortes aldrig.
strategies.peakActiveHint: Justeringen for spidsbelastning er aktiv lige nu, så det er ikke forudindstillingens egne vægte: 60 % af hastighedsvægten er flyttet til pålidelighed.
strategies.peakAdjustHint: Slået fra som standard. Inden for vinduet nedenfor flyttes 60 % af hastighedsvægten til pålidelighed — gratis relæer er mest belastede da, så pålidelighed forudsiger succes bedre end rå gennemstrømning. Hurtigst og Mest pålidelig røres ikke.
strategies.peakExemptNote: Denne forudindstilling røres ikke — den ligger allerede i den ene ende af afvejningen mellem hastighed og pålidelighed.
strategies.title: Routingstrategi
strategies.description: Vælg en routing-strategi. I manuel tilstand trækker du for at sætte rækkefølgen; De andre strategier følger live score på tværs af pålidelighed, hastighed og intelligens.
strategies.guardrailsTooltip: Altid-på-sikkerhedsforanstaltninger: gratis kvote-headroom × live prisbegrænsningsstraf. Under 1,0 betyder, at modellen holdes tilbage.
strategies.scoreTooltip: Endelig routingscore = vægtet gennemsnit af de tre akser, ganget med rækværket. Højere ruter først.
strategies.modeManualHint: Manuel tilstand: anmodninger følger rækkefølgen nedenfor, fra top til bund. Træk for at omorganisere.
strategies.modeScoreHint: Resultater opdateres fra live trafik. Rækkefølgen nedenfor viser, hvordan anmodninger bliver videresendt lige nu.
strategies.manualBlurb: Rute i den præcise rækkefølge, du har angivet nedenfor. Træk håndtagene for at omarrangere. Ingen scoring; kæden følges fra top til bund.
strategies.balancedBlurb: Pålidelighed fører (50 %), hvor hastighed og intelligens vægtes lige meget (25 % hver). En fornuftig allround-standard.
strategies.smartestBlurb: Foretrækker den mest kapable model, der stadig virker. Intelligens 55%, pålidelighed 35%, hastighed 10%.
strategies.fastestBlurb: Foretrækker den hurtigste model, der stadig virker. Hastighed 55%, pålidelighed 35%, intelligens 10%.
strategies.reliableBlurb: Maksimer succesraten frem for alt. Pålidelighed 70%, hastighed og intelligens 15% hver.
strategies.customBlurb: Sæt din egen balance mellem pålidelighed, hastighed og intelligens med skydere. Samme motor som presets, bare dine vægte.
strategies.customWeightsHelp: Sliders er uafhængige; Aktierne balancerer automatisk til 100%.
strategies.weightRequired: Mindst én vægt skal være over nul.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Save the routing data to a .sql file beside the database, and restore it later.
backups.excludedNote: A backup carries your providers, models, routing settings and request history. Accounts, sessions and URL tokens are never included, so a dump holds no password hashes or login tokens and restoring one cannot log you out. Provider keys stay encrypted with this server's ENCRYPTION_KEY: a backup can only be restored on a server that still holds that key.
backups.selectHint: Back up everything, or pick the tables you need.
backups.restored: Restored. The previous data was saved as {filename}.
backups.autoHint: The server writes a full backup on this cadence.
backups.pathHint: Relative to the database directory. Backups cannot be written outside it.

fusion.description: Et panel af modeller svarer parallelt, hvorefter en dommer syntetiserer et stærkere svar. Brug det ved at kalde API med modellen "fusion".
fusion.panelSourceHelp: Hvor panelmodellerne kommer fra, når en anmodning ikke specificerer sin egen.

mode.autoHelp: Vælg et varieret sæt modeller fra din Fallback Chain, rangeret efter din aktive routingstrategi.
mode.explicitHelp: Brug altid de specifikke modeller, du vælger nedenfor.

fusion.noModels: Der er endnu ikke forbundet nogen modeller. Tilføj en API-nøgle, og aktivér derefter modeller i Fallback-kæden.
fusion.panelSizeHelp: Hvor mange forskellige modeller skal man automatisk vælge (1–{max}).
fusion.judgeHelp: Modellen, der syntetiserer panelets svar til ét. Auto bruger din topplacerede model.
fusion.strategySynthesize: Syntetiser — sammensæt panelet til ét svar
fusion.strategyBestOf: Det bedste — giv det stærkeste svar tilbage (ingen dommerafgørelse)
fusion.exposePanelHelp: Vedhæft hver models svar og dommerens metadata under et x_fusion felt i svaret.
fusion.howToUseHelp: Send en normal chatanmodning med modellen "fusion". Disse indstillinger er standard; enhver anmodning kan tilsidesætte dem med et "fusion"-felt.

premium.title: Premium
premium.liveDescription: Nye gratis modeller, kvoteændringer og quirk-rettelser lander her inden for få timer efter forsendelsen. Appen tjekker automatisk to gange om dagen; Intet at lave.
premium.snapshotDescription: Gratis niveau: kataloget opdateres fra et månedligt øjebliksbillede, som tjekkes automatisk to gange dagligt. Premium skifter dette til live-feedet, som opdateres hver 2.-3. dag.
premium.willNotRenew: Vil ikke fornye. Premium indtil {date}, så falder denne installation tilbage til det gratis månedlige katalog.
premium.keyInactive: Denne nøgle er ikke længere aktiv. Appen fortsætter med at arbejde på den gratis månedlige katalog.
premium.manageHint: Administrer abonnementet åbner Stripe faktureringsportal: annuller, opdater dit kort eller download fakturaer. Fjernelse af nøglen deaktiverer kun denne enhed; Dit køb er uberørt.
premium.keyHint: Din nøgle er i din købsmail og på post-checkout-siden. Mistet den?
premium.upsellTitle: Gå live for 19 dollars om året
premium.upsellDescription: Nye gratis modeller i det øjeblik, de eksisterer, i stedet for 30 dage senere. Én nøgle, hver enhed. Annuller når som helst; Routeren forbliver fri for evigt.

setup.title: At komme i gang
setup.subtitle: Tre trin til at viderestille din første anmodning.

setup.step2Desc: Vælg en hvilken som helst model i Playground og sig hej.
setup.step3Desc: Brug din samlede API-nøgle med enhver OpenAI-kompatibel klient.

validation.url: Indtast en gyldig URL, der starter med http:// eller https://

agents.title: Kodningsagenter
agents.description: Forbind kodningsværktøjer til én gateway for gratis modeller med genereret, backup-sikker konfiguration.
agents.quickstart: Hurtigste vej: konfigurér Claude Code fra live-kataloget.
agents.setupHint: Skriver værktøjets konfigurationsfil for dig, rettet mod denne gateway.
agents.setupGuideHint: Viser værktøjets opsætningstrin; der skrives ingen filer.
agents.manualHint: Basis-URL og nøgle til værktøjets egne indstillinger.

descriptions.claude: Anthropic's terminal agent: it plans, edits files, and runs commands in your repo.
descriptions.codex: OpenAI's terminal agent, which runs your task in a local sandbox first.
descriptions.cline: A VS Code extension that asks you to approve every edit and command.
descriptions.continue: A VS Code and JetBrains extension for inline autocomplete and chat while you type.
descriptions.aider: A command-line pair programmer that turns each change into its own git commit.
descriptions.opencode: A provider-agnostic terminal agent with a full-screen text interface.
descriptions.goose: Block's local agent, extended with MCP servers to reach past your code.
descriptions.qwen: A Gemini CLI fork tuned for Qwen models and large repositories.
descriptions.roo: A VS Code extension with switchable modes: architect, coder, debugger.
descriptions.kilo: A VS Code extension merging Roo and Cline, with an orchestrator that splits up work.
descriptions.crush: Charm's terminal agent, written in Go, with one session per project.
descriptions.dsh: DeepSeek's harness, which keeps every provider as a route you can switch between.
descriptions.mimo: Xiaomi's terminal agent, an OpenCode fork that takes any OpenAI-compatible provider.
descriptions.cursor: The AI-first editor; it calls through Cursor's cloud, so it needs a public URL.
descriptions.generic: Anything else that speaks the OpenAI API, set up by hand from a base URL and key.
descriptions.atomcode: AtomGit's terminal agent, written in Rust, that takes any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
descriptions.openclaw: En altid tilgængelig personlig assistent, der svarer på WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord og mere fra din egen maskine.
descriptions.hermes: Nous Researchs selvforbedrende agent med vedvarende hukommelse og færdigheder, i terminalen eller i chat-apps.

freeTier.empty: No enabled models with free-tier budget data.
freeTier.poolBudgetTitle: One monthly allowance for the whole pool, scaled by the {count} usable keys on this platform. Every model listed under it draws from the same budget.

chains.title: Fallback chains
chains.description: Named chains, each callable as auto:<name> in /v1/models.
chains.activateHint: Make this the chain the table below edits and the one auto routes through
chains.nameRules: Up to 20 characters: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
chains.startEmptyHint: Create the chain with no models in it, and keep new catalog models out of it. Unchecked, it starts as a copy of the default chain.
chains.curatedHint: New catalog models are not added to this chain automatically.
chains.renameConfirm: Omdøb kæden "{oldName}" til "{name}"? Klients, der kalder auto:{oldName}, skal skifte til auto:{name}.

compare.pageDescription: Measured intelligence, coding and agentic scores from Artificial Analysis, mapped onto the models you route.
compare.keyHint: Benchmark data is fetched with your own key and cached here. The free tier carries the three headline indices and allows 100 requests per day, so syncing is manual.
compare.keyReplace: Paste a new key to replace the stored one
compare.keyUnreadable: A key is stored but cannot be decrypted — ENCRYPTION_KEY has changed since it was saved. Paste it again.
compare.empty: No benchmark data yet. Add a key and press Refresh data.
compare.tableHint: Tick models to narrow the chart above. Our own rank sits beside the measured scores so you can see where the two disagree.
compare.searchPlaceholder: Search model, provider, chain or benchmark
compare.scopePickAdd: Add which routes to the key scope?
compare.scopePickRemove: Remove which routes from the key scope?
compare.scopeAddHint: This provider key does not name this model, so the router cannot use it. Add it to the key scope.
compare.scopeRemoveHint: Remove this model from the provider key scope, so the router stops using it
compare.scopeRoutedHint: Models a routing chain is using right now
compare.scopeKeyedHint: Every model on a provider we hold a usable key for, including ones switched off in the catalogue
compare.scopeEnabledHint: Switched on in the catalogue AND on a provider we hold a usable key for - the models you could route to today
compare.scopeAllHint: Every model discovered from every provider, including ones we have no key for
compare.notMeasured: {count} of these have no score for this index.
compare.chainEdit: Choose which chains route to this model
compare.chainPick: Chains that may route to this model
compare.speedHint: Median output tokens per second, measured by Artificial Analysis
compare.latencyHint: Median time to first token in seconds, measured by Artificial Analysis
compare.conflictHint: Members of this group are mapped to different Artificial Analysis models. Pick one for the group, or unmerge.
compare.upgradeTitleOne: An estimated model now has real benchmark data
compare.upgradeTitle: {count} estimated models now have real benchmark data
compare.upgradeHint: These were mapped to a stand-in because nothing measured them. Artificial Analysis now publishes the model itself, so the borrowed scores and your adjustments can be replaced with measurements.
compare.matchProxyHint: Not published by Artificial Analysis. Scores are borrowed from {name} ({slug}) and adjusted by hand, so they are an estimate.
compare.mapAriaLabel: Map this model to a benchmark
compare.costBasis: USD per 1M tokens exactly as Artificial Analysis publishes them — unblended, sorted by input price.
compare.filterOpencodeHint: Show only OpenCode models with baselines for comparison

fleet.title: Free CLI fleet
fleet.description: What each machine can reach on the free CLI rosters, and what it has spent. Machines report their own state; FreeLLM stores what it is told.
fleet.notRoutable: Observation only — these routes cannot be called from FreeLLM. Their free tiers refuse callers outside the vendor's own CLI, so they never appear in routing or model pickers.
fleet.proxyScoreHint: This score is an estimate for a related variant, not a measurement of this route.
fleet.staleWarning: This machine has not reported for {ago}. Its rows may no longer be true.
fleet.emptyHint: Run clifree-report.sh --post on a machine with the free CLIs installed.
fleet.legendFleet: reachable only from a free CLI agent, never from FreeLLM
fleet.legendBoth: A model showing both marks is reachable from either agent.
fleet.legendServed: Marks with no CLI fleet badge: FreeLLM can serve it too, and an agent can also reach it.
fleet.valueHint: Market value of the inference this machine was given: the published per-million rates of each route's benchmark equivalent, applied to the tokens it actually consumed. Not what we paid, which is nothing.
fleet.valueUnknownHint: No route this machine used maps to a benchmark that publishes a price, so the inference cannot be valued. Unpriced is not the same as worthless.

compare.scopeClifreeHint: Routes a free CLI agent can actually drive, as reported by your machines. Not a platform filter: a catalogue route no machine reports is excluded, and Cline's free models appear only in the fleet table below — FreeLLM cannot call them.
compare.resetHint: Back to defaults: intelligence chart, routed scope, no search, nothing pinned.
compare.costBasisTask: USD Artificial Analysis measured to run one task of its Intelligence Index, cheapest first. Covers only the models AA has run it on.

catalogue.changesHint: Models added since {since}, and retirements not yet acknowledged.
catalogue.changesShowUnkeyed: Show {count} more on providers with no key

quota.title: Quota
quota.emptyShadow: No shadow decisions recorded yet — these appear once traffic flows
quota.shadowCaveat: Shadow records which provider quota-aware scoring would have preferred. It cannot say that choice would have been better — the preferred provider never ran.
quota.agreementSummary: {agreed} of {total} decisions agreed with the live router.
quota.emptyDivergence: No disagreements recorded — the two routers have picked the same provider every time so far.
quota.locallyCountedHint: The provider never reported this pool; the count is ours, against a limit we hold.
quota.burnCaveat: Spends this provider’s free allowance until it refuses, to find out what the allowance is. The allowance does not come back until the provider’s own reset. Capped at 120 requests or 3 minutes per run; finds the tightest limit, then times the refusal to identify which one it was.
quota.derivedAllowanceHint: Derived from measured usage against the reported fraction: {low}–{high} across {samples} intervals
quota.policyEditorHint: Declare a limit and its reset for a provider that does not report one. Operator policies outrank documentation and catalogue figures, and are outranked by anything the provider measures.
quota.resetInferredHint: Predicted from observed reset boundaries — this provider sends no reset time. Accurate to within the polling interval.
quota.probesHint: What a provider’s limits were measured to be, and whether the catalogue agrees. Measuring spends real quota, so each run is kept.
quota.probeClaimedThen: The catalogue claimed {claimed} when this ran, and has since been corrected.
quota.windowKindHint: A rolling window frees one call at a time as the oldest ages out. A calendar window returns the whole allowance at midnight in the named zone.
quota.notInChain: enabled, but excluded by the active chain — spends nothing
quota.limitFromPoolHint: No limit of its own: this model spends the provider allowance shown on the pool row above.
quota.bucketNoResetHint: This allowance refills continuously rather than resetting: spend one and it returns after the interval shown, so there is no boundary to wait for.
quota.bindsFirstHint: One allowance, measured over more than one window. This is the window with the least headroom, so it is the one that will refuse the next request.
quota.poolSummedHint: This total is the sum of the models below, each of which holds its own allowance — not a ceiling the provider stated.

extensions.paidWarning: Turning this off lets automatic routing and fallback spend real credit on OpenRouter, AnyAPI and unorouter. This is not a spending limit — there is no cap behind it. Naming a paid model explicitly already works and is unaffected. Type {phrase} to authorise it.
extensions.title: Imperium extensions
extensions.intro: Features added by the separate Imperium FreeLLMAPI branch. Each switch turns one extension off without deleting anything it has stored; the links open the pages that own its real settings.
extensions.footer: Switching an extension off hides its surface and stops its behaviour. It never drops a table, a saved scope or a merge you have already made — see “When off” on each entry.
